B. नाभि at the end of Bah. comp. becomes नाभ when the comp. is used as an epithet; as पद्मनाभः.) --Comp. --आवर्तः the cavity of the navel. --कंटकः, --गु (गो) लकः ruptured navel. --जः, --जन्मन् m., --भूः epithets of Brahmā. --नाडी, --नालं {1} the umbilical cord. {2} rupture of the navel. --मूलं the part of the body immediately under the navel. --वर्धनं {1} cutting or division of the umbilical cord. {2} rupture of the navel. {3} corpulency.

s: puM, (nABeragnIDraputtrasya varzaH .) BAratavarzaH । yaTA, “yo'sO manuputtraH priyavrato nAma saptadvIpADipatirbaBUva tasya cAgnIDrAdayo daSa puttrA baBUvuH trayaH pravrajitAH SizwAnAM saptAnAM sapta dvIpAH pitrA dattAH । tatra jambadvIpADipateScAgnIDrasya nava puttrA baBUvuH । nABiH kiMpuruzaScEva harivarza ilAvftaH । ramyo hiraRmayaScEva kururBadrASvaketumAn ॥ nava varzARi teByaH pitrA dattAni vanaM praviSatA cAgnIDreRa । himAlayasyADipaternABerfzaBaH puttro baBUva fzaBAdBarataH Baratena cirakAlaM DarmmeRa SAsitatvAdidaM BArataM varzamaBUta .” iti nArasiMhe 30 aDyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ nABerAgnIDranfpaputrasya varzaH । jambudvIpasTe navavarzamaDye varmaBede nABiSabde dfSyam tasya nAmisaMjYakatve'pi paScAt tatkulajamaratanAmnA tat KyAtaM taTAhi nfsiMhapu॰ 30 a॰ nAmiputrasya fzamasya putro Baratastena ciraM pAlitatvAdasya BAratavarzeti saMjYoktA । nABivarzasya BAratavarzanAmatA darSitA fzamaSabde 1451 pf॰ dfSyA । ataeva vizRupu॰ “nABiSca praTasaM varzamityupakrame mava varzAspi uktvA “BAratasyAsya varzasya nava BedAnniSAmaya” iti । nABivarzasyEva BAratavarzatvena uktiH ।
m: नाभि—वर्ष m. n. the Varṣa governed by Nābhi (son of Agnīdhra), Pur.

s: tri, (nABeridamiti । nABi + yat .) nABisambanDi । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 3 । 4 । 13 । “purA mayA proktamajAya nABye padme nizaRRAya mamAdisarge ॥” nABaye hitam । “SarIrAvayavAt yat .” 5 । 1 । 6 । iti yat । “nABi naBaSca .” 5 । 1 । 2 । ityasya vArttikoktyA nABernaBAdeSastu na Bavati । asya gavAditayA sanniyogaSizwatvAt raTanABAveva pravftteH । nAmihite ca ॥ mahAdeve, puM । yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 184 । 19 । “namo nABAya nAByAya namaH kawakawAya ca ॥”)
